Study: 1 round; needs navigate, probe and gather.
details.effects: start: resource, radius around x, y (default your position), path, time, energy, reserve, quantity. Candidates: sources of that resource you see now, or remember out of view, inside the radius, with ripe stock; nearest reach first; sources made by another person are left alone. It walks to one with navigate, inspects it with probe, then gathers min(stock, quantity left, units the energy allows). Sources seen empty are noted, not visited. If none is known it may walk to observed dry ground inside the radius to see its unseen parts; one known but beyond the limits stops it. It completes at the quantity or when nothing is left (perhaps with 0), and stops at a limit, health <= 60, satiety <= 8, body temperature 10 from 22 or an injury in the last round. Another action pauses it; resume rechecks all; cancel or death ends it. Nothing is refunded, created or eaten; no reward.

All paged records use600-code-unit fragments with zero-based part0..parts-1, consistently in proactive and queried views. Current-scope retained queries are reprojected using these stable pages; original results remain archived. Queries expose no hidden properties, other private records or historical capabilities. value.costs: Study 1 round, no energy; needs probe. inspect: probe observe, 1 round, 0.2 energy, no material. trial (methodRef press, wet or heat; intensity is the press load): probe's trial, 1 round, 0.5 energy and 0.1 unit of your own sample, consumed as loss; heat also takes 0.1 available heat from a source in reach, wet needs water where you stand. A trial needs a cited verified probe record of the same kind, method and load to compare with, since a load, water or heat response measures no nutrition, harm or preparation; otherwise it is refused, naming what is missing. Refusals cost nothing: target not seen now (only remembered or named), out of reach, another person's item, not a material, consumer not you or a person you see, unknown record ids. No surcharge, no refund.
value.effects: target: exact id of your item, a loose item or a source in reach. evidenceRefs: up to 6 ids of your records (record key or its evidence id, an eating record by its kind, a heard message id). intendedConsumer: you by default or a person you see; only your own records are used. Identity is supported only by your own eating record of the same kind, never by a name or label; only then are its satiety and health loss cited, and preparation is none for units as you ate them. A trial response that differs from the reference contradicts identity; a match identifies nothing. Without applicable evidence: "safety unresolved; do not consume on this evidence." An event and your record <target>:food-suitability keep the findings, evidence and limits. Nothing is gathered, moved, created, detoxified, certified or rewarded.
